calm.caption: Twins leave together. Both paths must be clear.
Compass arrows turn a quarter each time something leaves.
Moon arrows are asleep. Send the star arrow away to wake them.
Mirrors turn an arrow on its way out. Follow the new path.
Patient arrows show a number. They can leave after that many launches.
Ghost arrows swap form on every launch. Play them only when solid.
Phase arrows can slip through one blocked tile on their way out.
Play this arrow before its count runs out, or it gets a red card.
Reverse arrows swap their tip to the other end on every launch.

winter.caption: Ice can trap arrows. Hit a frozen arrow with another arrow to free it.

spring.caption: Flowers block arrows. Each launch, a bee carries one away.

summer.caption: Burning tiles stop arrows for a few launches. Wait, or find another way.

autumn.caption: Wind can spin arrows around their tails when there is room.
